summary: Tested badge-approval workflow additions (sidebar count badge, optional coaching note on approve/deny, bulk approve/deny). All backend endpoints and UI flows verified. 12/12 pytest tests pass; playwright verified sidebar count, decision dialog, bulk actions, CustomEvent-driven refresh, and scout-hides-badge behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend deny endpoint's Optional[BadgeDecisionIn] with default None works, but FastAPI treats Optional[BaseModel] parameters as body when JSON is sent — verified. Consider requiring an empty {} body from the client for clarity.
bulk endpoint silently skips out-of-chapter with reason 'forbidden' — good UX; make sure UI doesn't rely on top-level status to flag partial failures.
Sidebar polling every 60s + CustomEvent 'badge-requests-changed' works; consider debouncing to avoid rapid duplicate refetches when many events fire in a burst.
test_credentials: See /app/memory/test_credentials.md — admin/leader/scout logins used and valid.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 3 new pending badge requests as scout narek@scouts.am (chp_ararat) via POST /api/badges/request for UI test. Cleaned up via bulk approve during test flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 features (count endpoint, note body on approve/deny, bulk endpoint, sidebar red badge with data-testid 'nav-badge-count--badges', decision dialog with note textarea maxLength=400, bulk action bar with bulk-approve-start/bulk-award/bulk-deny/bulk-clear) all working end-to-end.
